events.summary: Mercury launched Mercury Payroll on Oct 20, 2026, letting founders run W-2 and 1099 payroll, benefits, and tax compliance from their Mercury account with AI assistance via Mercury Command; it is free through Dec 31, 2026, then $100/month plus $50/month per person paid starting Jan 1, 2027.
events.headline: Mercury launches AI-native Mercury Payroll

events.summary: Mercury enabled ChatGPT and Claude to move money, pay recipients, and categorize transactions on a Mercury account via MCP, with every action requiring user approval.
events.headline: Take action on your Mercury account from ChatGPT and Claude

events.summary: Mercury added faster priority support for customers on its paid Plus and Pro subscription plans as of Oct 14, 2026, while all customers retain 24/7 support.
events.headline: Priority Support now available for Plus and Pro customers

events.summary: Multiple Mercury accounts can now be linked to move money between them, with instant transfers between accounts on the same partner bank, auto-transfer rules, and recurring external transfers.
events.headline: All your accounts, connected

events.summary: Mercury added real-time payments to its API (paymentMethod: realTimePayment), delivering funds in seconds 24/7/365 on Business and Personal accounts provided through Column, N.A.
events.headline: Send real-time payments with the Mercury API

events.summary: Mercury enabled wire drawdowns from accounts provided through both Column, N.A. and Choice Financial Group, so payroll providers like Sequoia and Gusto can withdraw funds directly.
events.headline: Authorize wire drawdowns for payroll
